Definition: from G1121. a writer, i.e. (professionally) scribe or secretary:--scribe, town-clerk.
BiblicalUsage: grammateús is the word for scribe, town-clerk. In Matthew 2:4, the text says "And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together." In Mark 1:22, the text says "and not as the scribes."
TheologicalSignificance: I believe grammateús shows us that God's Word means what it says, and this word is part of how He speaks plainly to us. That shapes how I read the passages where it appears: not as filler, but as God's own wording for what He is doing.
RelatedEvents: The Healing of the Paralytic; The Magi Visit Jesus; Jesus Heals a Demoniac in the Capernaum Synagogue
